toolsAdded.name: navigate_tree
toolsAdded.description:
Long-session context management via the pi session tree. Anchor named milestones, then collapse work between them into a model-generated summary to free context.
`rewind` does not restore prior state: it forks a sibling branch from the anchor and continues forward from a model-generated summary.

Operations (set `action`):
  • 'anchor', name='<milestone-name>': label the current point. Anchor at the start of a stage you'll summarize (e.g. 'impl-start').
  • 'rewind', rewindTo='<existing>', newLabel='<new>': collapse work between rewindTo and the current leaf into a branch_summary labeled newLabel, so rewinds can chain.
  • 'list': show all anchors on the active branch, oldest first, with cumulative context % at each.
  • 'pin', kind='sub-goal'|'decision'|'fact'|'file'|'steering', text='<what to keep>': record a durable item that survives folds; `list` shows them. 'file' takes path+why instead of text; 'steering' belongs to an anchor (scopeAnchor, default newest). Refused when the user disabled the continuity ledger (continuity.capture=false).

`name` (anchor) and `newLabel` (rewind) write into one shared anchor namespace: labels are unique on the active branch — both actions refuse a name that already exists — and everything written there is addressable as a future `rewindTo`. Avoid the reserved `anchor:` prefix.

name.description: Required when action='anchor'. Kebab-case milestone label, max 40 chars.

rewindTo.description: Required when action='rewind'. Kebab-case name of an existing anchor on the active branch to rewind to.

newLabel.description: Required when action='rewind'. Kebab-case label for the resulting branch_summary entry; reusable as a future rewindTo.

summaryFocus.description: Required when action='rewind'; ≥20 chars after trim. Encode: (1) the user's most recent instruction verbatim, (2) what's done in the collapsed segment, (3) what's left to do as a next action; if the user authorized continuing, name the next work item, not a report or wrap-up.

kind.description: Required when action='pin'. Your sub-goal, a decision you made, a key fact, a file pointer, or steering that lapses when its anchor is folded.

text.description: Required when action='pin' unless kind='file'. What to remember, max 500 chars.

path.description: Required when action='pin' and kind='file'. File path.

lines.description: Optional with kind='file': N or N-M.

why.description: Required when action='pin' and kind='file'. Why the file matters.

scopeAnchor.description: Anchor name for kind='steering' (default: newest anchor); optional for 'sub-goal'.
